se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom 0.9.9 发布, Bill of Materials for the VibeTags annotation processor. Import this BOM to get
        a coherent vibetags-annotations + vibetags-processor pair without specifying
        each version individually.

        Recommended setup — annotations on the compile classpath, processor on the
        annotation-processor path only (the processor jar pulls in slf4j/logback,
        which has no business on consumer code's compileClasspath):

        Maven:
            <dependencyManagement>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                        <artifactId>vibetags-bom</artifactId>
                        <version>0.9.9</version>
                        <type>pom</type>
                        <scope>import</scope>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
            </dependencyManagement>

        Gradle:
            implementation platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:0.9.9')
            annotationProcessor platform('se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-bom:0.9.9')
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor'

se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations 0.9.9 发布, VibeTags annotation classes (@AILocked, @AIContext, @AIDraft, @AIAudit,
        @AIIgnore, @AIPrivacy, @AICore, @AIPerformance). Zero third-party dependencies.
        All annotations use RetentionPolicy.SOURCE so they leave no trace in the
        consumer's compiled bytecode — this jar exists purely to give javac the
        symbols it needs at compile time.

        Pair this with vibetags-processor on the annotation-processor classpath:

        Maven:
            <dependency>
                <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                <artifactId>vibetags-annotations</artifactId>
                <version>0.9.7</version>
            </dependency>

        Gradle:
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations:0.9.7'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor:0.9.7'

items.title:
io.github.adepusricharan:spring-security-explainer 1.2.1 发布, Spring Security Explainer is a zero-configuration Spring Boot security starter.
        It provides JWT access + refresh token authentication, role-based authorization (@RequireRole),
        permission-based authorization (@RequirePermission), ownership checks (@RequireOwner via SpEL),
        and refresh token rotation with replay-attack detection — all out of the box.
        Developers only need to implement UserAccountProvider to integrate with their database.
        No filters, no JWT wiring, no SecurityFilterChain needed.
        All components are fully overridable via Spring Boot auto-configuration (@ConditionalOnMissingBean).
        Built-in endpoints: POST /login, POST /refresh, POST /logout.
        GitHub: https://github.com/AdepuSriCharan/spring-security-starter
